verdict.rationale: Segment's docs show a Privacy Portal, consent management, and 'detect and classify customer data' plus governance messaging (GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA), suggesting some PII controls exist, but none of the evidence describes concrete per-destination controls like hashing, masking, or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of hashing/masking transforms, field-level filtering rules scoped to individual destinations, and any hands-on/independent confirmation these mechanisms work as described.
